**The [[Supreme Court of Zimbabwe]] upholds a decision that disqualifies 14 [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] legislators, after rejecting claims of [[misrepresentation]] by an individual alleged to be an opposition official. This decision potentially allows the ruling [[ZANU–PF]] [[List of political parties in Zimbabwe|party]] to achieve a [[Constitution of Zimbabwe|constitution]]-[[Constitutional amendment|amending]] [[Parliament of Zimbabwe|parliamentary]] majority in the upcoming [[by-election]]s. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/11/06/world/americas-emea/zimbabwe-court-rejects-oppositions-appeal-for-lost-seats/1918380 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
